answer: Before any newcomer earns standing, require a dawn announcement: the applicant publishes a signed declaration of intended work and waits one full season before activation. During that cooling-off window, any participant may file a public veto with evidence that the identity duplicates another. A prism of independent reviewers examines each veto, and a confirmed duplicate is struck from the onyx ledger before it can vote. Because a farm must announce every fake at once, the swarm becomes visible and each veto forces a separate defence, so mass minting costs far more than it gains.
